history.title: History
history.description: KASUM was founded in 2018 by Felipe M. and Alina C. with the aim of simplifying financial management and providing a user-friendly platform for anyone to use.
history.description2: The project was initially developed as a personal project, but it quickly gained popularity among users and has since been adopted by various organizations.

simplify.title: Simplify Financial Management
simplify.description: KASUM is a user-friendly platform that simplifies financial management by providing a simple and intuitive interface for users to register their income and expenses, get detailed reports, and track their financial goals.

empower.title: Empower Users
empower.description: KASUM empowers users to take control of their finances by providing them with the tools and features they need to manage their finances effectively and efficiently.

security.title: Secure Financial Data
security.description: KASUM ensures the security and privacy of financial data by implementing robust security measures and encryption protocols to protect user data.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This privacy policy (“Policy”) explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website (“Site”). This Policy applies to all information collected on the Site, including information you provide through the Site, as well as any information we collect automatically when you use the Site. By using the Site, you agree to the terms of this Policy.

information_collected.title: Information We Collect
information_collected.content: We may collect personal information from you when you register on the Site, such as your name, email address, phone number, and other contact information. We may also collect information from you when you interact with the Site, such as your IP address, browser type, and the pages you visit. We may collect information about your use of the Site, including the pages you visit, the time and date of your visit, the links you click on, and other information that may help us improve the Site. We may also collect non-personal information, such as your location, browsing history, and search queries. This information may be used to provide you with targeted advertising, to improve our website, to better understand your needs and preferences, or to detect and prevent fraud.

use_of_information.title: Use of Information
use_of_information.content: We use the information we collect to provide and improve the Site, its services, and the products and services offered through the Site. We may use your information to personalize your experience on the Site, to provide and deliver products and services that may be of interest to you, and to improve our website and our services. We may also use your information to communicate with you about other products and services we offer, to respond to your feedback, and to provide you with customer support.

sharing_of_information.title: Sharing of Information
sharing_of_information.content: We do not share personal information about you with third parties, except as necessary to provide you with our products and services, to fulfill your orders, or to protect your rights or property. We may share aggregated and non-personal information about you with our affiliates, advertisers, and other third parties for their own marketing purposes.

security.title: Security
security.content: We take appropriate measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information. We will take reasonable measures to protect your information from loss, misuse, or alteration.

changes.title: Changes to this Policy
changes.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We encourage you to review this Policy periodically for any changes. Your continued use of the Site after any changes to this Policy constitutes your acceptance of the updated Policy. If you do not agree to any changes to this Policy, you should discontinue your use of the Site.
